import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# ============================================================
# 1. Select Variables
# ============================================================

x = df["Quantity"]
y = df["TotalPrice"]

# Remove missing values
data = df[["Quantity", "TotalPrice"]].dropna()

x = data["Quantity"]
y = data["TotalPrice"]


# ============================================================
# 2. Calculate Correlation
# ============================================================

correlation, p_value = pearsonr(x, y)

print("Pearson Correlation:", round(correlation, 3))
print("P-value:", round(p_value, 5))


# ============================================================
# 3. Sort Data for Trend Line
# ============================================================

sort_idx = np.argsort(x)

x_sorted = x.iloc[sort_idx]
y_sorted = y.iloc[sort_idx]


# ============================================================
# 4. Rolling Average
# ============================================================

# Fixed window to avoid max() error
window = 20

y_trend = y_sorted.rolling(
    window=window,
    min_periods=1
).mean()


# ============================================================
# 5. Create Figure
# ============================================================

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15, 8))

# Dark background
fig.patch.set_facecolor("#08141C")
ax.set_facecolor("#0B1720")


# ============================================================
# 6. Scatter Plot
# ============================================================

ax.scatter(
    x,
    y,
    color="#00B4D8",
    alpha=0.45,
    s=30,
    edgecolors="none"
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Neon Trend Line
# ============================================================

# Glow effect
ax.plot(
    x_sorted,
    y_trend,
    color="#00F5FF",
    linewidth=12,
    alpha=0.04
)

ax.plot(
    x_sorted,
    y_trend,
    color="#00F5FF",
    linewidth=7,
    alpha=0.08
)

ax.plot(
    x_sorted,
    y_trend,
    color="#00F5FF",
    linewidth=4,
    alpha=1,
    label="Observed Relationship"
)


# ============================================================
# 8. Warning Symbol
# ============================================================

ax.text(
    0.50,
    0.82,
    "⚠",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=55,
    color="#FFD43B",
    ha="center",
    va="center"
)


# ============================================================
# 9. Main Title
# ============================================================

ax.text(
    0.5,
    1.08,
    "The Golden Rule: Correlation ≠ Causation",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=25,
    fontweight="bold",
    color="#F2F2F2",
    ha="center"
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Correlation Information
# ============================================================

ax.text(
    0.03,
    0.94,
    f"Pearson r = {correlation:.3f}",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=12,
    color="#00F5FF",
    fontweight="bold"
)

ax.text(
    0.03,
    0.89,
    f"p-value = {p_value:.5f}",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=11,
    color="#B8F7FF"
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Potential Confounder
# ============================================================

ax.text(
    0.68,
    0.78,
    "Unit Price",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=15,
    color="#FFD43B",
    fontweight="bold"
)

ax.text(
    0.68,
    0.73,
    "(Potential Confounder)",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=11,
    color="white"
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Variable Labels
# ============================================================

ax.text(
    0.78,
    0.48,
    "Total Price",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=14,
    color="white",
    fontweight="bold"
)

ax.text(
    0.78,
    0.43,
    "(Order Value)",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=11,
    color="#B8F7FF"
)
# 13. Forensic Note
note = (
    "Forensic Note: A correlation is a CLUE, not a VERDICT.\n"
    "Always check for hidden variables before claiming causation."
)

ax.text(
    0.5,
    -0.14,
    note,
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=13,
    color="#F2F2F2",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontweight="bold",
    bbox=dict(
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.8",
        facecolor="#101F29",
        edgecolor="#8DEBFF",
        linewidth=1.5
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Axis Labels
# ============================================================

ax.set_xlabel(
    "Quantity",
    fontsize=13,
    color="white",
    labelpad=12
)

ax.set_ylabel(
    "Total Price ($)",
    fontsize=13,
    color="white",
    labelpad=12
)


# ============================================================
# 15. Grid
# ============================================================

ax.grid(
    True,
    color="#173441",
    linestyle="-",
    linewidth=0.7,
    alpha=0.8
)


# ============================================================
# 16. Axis Styling
# ============================================================

ax.tick_params(
    colors="#B8F7FF",
    labelsize=10
)

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

ax.spines["left"].set_color("#00D9FF")
ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#00D9FF")


# ============================================================
# 17. Legend
# ============================================================

legend = ax.legend(
    loc="upper left",
    frameon=False,
    fontsize=11
)

for text in legend.get_texts():
    text.set_color("white")


# ============================================================
# 18. Final Layout
# ============================================================

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Pearson Correlation: 0.615
P-value: 0.0

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.gca().set_facecolor("#0B1720")

sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x="Quantity",
    y="TotalPrice",
    scatter_kws={"color": "#00B4D8", "alpha": 0.5},
    line_kws={"color": "#FF4D6D", "linewidth": 3}
)

plt.title(
    "The Golden Rule: Correlation ≠ Causation",
    color="white",
    fontsize=18,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.xlabel("Quantity", color="white")
plt.ylabel("Total Price ($)", color="white")

plt.tick_params(colors="white")
plt.grid(color="#34495E", alpha=0.5)

plt.show()
